summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry describing Pak Tam Chung, an area located in the southern part of the Sai Kung Peninsula in Hong Kong's New Territories. It states that the area falls administratively under the Sai Kung District.
one_line: Pak Tam Chung is an area in the southern Sai Kung Peninsula of Hong Kong's New Territories, administered under Sai Kung District.
key_facts: Pak Tam Chung is an area in the southern part of the Sai Kung Peninsula.
Pak Tam Chung is located in the New Territories of Hong Kong.
Pak Tam Chung is administratively under the Sai Kung District.
